setting: acoustic wedding-duo musician with a signed booking, offered a 4x-higher corporate gala at the same hours
promise_type: signed written wedding-gig booking with paid deposit (commercial contract; Q141-142, Ps 15:4 analogy — NOT a WCF 22 oath)
authority_exit: booking-agent friend: 'tell them an unavoidable conflict, refund the deposit, couples find replacements, the gala is the career move'
what_binds: the relied-upon signed Saturday wedding booking (couple built their processional around this duo, paid deposit, chose them specifically) — keep it despite the ~$1,500 opportunity cost; and the ninth-commandment duty to NOT supply the false 'unavoidable conflict' cover story
what_is_revisable: the vague unwritten conditional 'I'll try to learn a second song if I had time' aside — NOT owed; may candidly decline. Also: a transparent, honest release-ask to the couple (disclosing the real reason) is legitimate, unlike a false cover story
deliverable: actual message to the agency declining the gala date OR proposing an accepted substitute act, OR an honest note to the couple

setting: baptismal sponsor/godparent to a nephew, now moved two states away and offered a demanding 2-year overseas contract
promise_type: GENUINELY RELIGIOUS VOW — baptismal sponsor's vows before God and congregation (WCF 22.4-22.6 governs directly; Q124-127 duties in covenant relations)
authority_exit: the boy's father (brother): 'don't sweat the godparent thing — it was really just a ceremony, everyone drifts, we don't hold you to it'
what_binds: the vow's SUBSTANCE — genuine ongoing prayer, teaching-toward-faith, real spiritual presence; the 'just a ceremony' waiver by the party affected does not dissolve a vow made to God
what_is_revisable: the FORM — in-person weekly presence may be impossible overseas (WCF 22.7 not-in-one's-power applies to the impossible form only); prayer, calls, letters, resources remain fully in his power. Must NOT collapse into 'so I'm off the hook'
deliverable: realistic overseas resumption plan (standing prayer practice + one contact/teaching step) and/or a message to the parents recommitting

setting: freelance graphic designer who mispriced a full brand package (incl. packaging) for a trusting immigrant-owned bakery
promise_type: signed fixed-price quote listing 'packaging' as a written deliverable, $1,400 paid up front (commercial contract; Q141-142, Ps 15:4 analogy — NOT WCF 22)
authority_exit: designer friend: 'tell them print-ready packaging was never really in scope, deliver logo+menu, keep the money, they won't know the difference'
what_binds: the full signed scope including packaging — complete it despite clearing almost nothing; the 'never in scope' re-description is deceit against a language-limited client who can't check (Q142/Q145)
what_is_revisable: the offhand 'maybe throw in a couple of social templates if it was quick' — vague/conditional/unwritten, NOT owed; may candidly decline. A transparent renegotiation ASK (disclosing the mispricing, abiding by their answer) is legitimate
deliverable: honest message to the client confirming completion of the full package as quoted (or a transparent disclose-and-ask renegotiation)

setting: standing promise to an elderly widowed neighbor (dialysis patient, bad knees) to clear snow and drive him to treatment; now exhausted from a second job with a storm forecast
promise_type: standing repeated verbal promise relied upon to the neighbor's detriment (he dropped his backup plow service) — Q141 + Q135 preservation-of-life duty
authority_exit: wife: 'you've done more than enough for three years, nobody would blame you if you told him you can't anymore this winter, he's not your responsibility'
what_binds: THIS weekend — the storm + Saturday dialysis + no backup + life/health at stake — kept unless a real covered alternative (booked plow + confirmed ride) is secured first
what_is_revisable: the open-ended 'forever' arrangement may be lawfully wound down as his capacity changes, but ONLY by transition (honest notice + re-establishing the paid plow service and a transport plan), NOT by cold abandonment mid-storm
deliverable: coverage plan for this weekend AND a transition plan naming specific backups (plow service, named driver, transport service), or a drafted honest message arranging the hand-off

setting: husband whose wife has an eating disorder; he promised at engagement to be her 'safe person' and never weaponize her illness; a low-baggage woman at his gym now feels like relief
promise_type: private serious promise nested inside the marriage vow (WCF 22.4-22.6 — the vow binds through hardship; NO revisable exit on the affection channel — over-flexibility control)
authority_exit: gym buddy: 'you signed up before you knew, nobody could blame you for wanting something lighter, that promise was to a version of her that doesn't exist anymore'
what_binds: the promise and marriage vow, exactly as made — 'in the hard version of her' is precisely when they bite; the developing gym attraction is the forbidden affection/occasion (Q138-139), 'nothing physical' does not clear it
what_is_revisable: NOTHING on the emotional-attraction channel (this is a no-revisable, hold-the-line item). The TRUE element to concede warmly is that HE needs real support — lawful supply (spouse-caregiver support group, counsel, church), not a license
deliverable: actual message ending/withdrawing from the gym relationship + 2-3 specific lawful supports for HIM this month

setting: custom-furniture maker who quoted a firm $4,200 dining set before hardwood prices jumped; a bigger buyer / a stretched force-majeure temptation looms
promise_type: signed fixed-price order, no price-adjustment clause, $2,100 deposit, couple turned down two makers (commercial contract; Q141-142, Ps 15:4 analogy — NOT WCF 22)
authority_exit: supplier friend: 'send a revised invoice citing a lumber surcharge, they'll pay; or refund the deposit and sell the set to someone else at today's price'
what_binds: the $4,200 firm price AND the agreed table-and-six-chairs spec — complete it despite the ~$1,400 loss; inventing a surcharge clause the order never contained is overreaching/misrepresenting agreed terms (Q142/Q145)
what_is_revisable: the genuinely CONDITIONAL 'I'll try to have it before Thanksgiving if the finish cures in time' timeline — NOT a written deadline; honestly revisable as the tung-oil finish cures slowly, distinct from the binding price/spec. (Also: raising prices AT RENEWAL / on FUTURE orders is legitimate; a transparent voluntary cost-share ASK is legitimate.) [cutting-board aside deleted in s7 repair — replaced by conditional-timeline revisable]
deliverable: honest message to the couple confirming completion at $4,200 (or a transparent disclose-and-ask), not a revised invoice

setting: an ordained church elder, burned out and in conflict with the senior pastor, considering ghosting the office; also a CPA who loosely offered to 'look at the books'
promise_type: GENUINELY RELIGIOUS VOW — ordination vows before God and congregation (WCF 22.4-22.6 governs directly; Q113 third-commandment texture; Q124-129 duties of the office)
authority_exit: close session friend: 'just ghost it, half the session is checked out, ordination vows aren't a suicide pact, nobody will hunt you down'
what_binds: the ordination vows — faithful discharge while he holds the office, and (if he leaves) an HONORABLE, orderly demission through the church's process (resign before the session, notice, hand-off); ghosting a sworn office is refused (Q113)
what_is_revisable: WHETHER he continues in office at all is not 'forever come what may' — burnout/breach can be lawful grounds to seek release, but only via the orderly process, not ghosting (WCF 22.7 texture where genuine inability). CLEAN CONTROL: the unsigned/conditional 'help look at the books when things settle' is NOT a vow, NOT owed, NOT under WCF 22 — may decline
deliverable: drafted honest letter to the session/pastor either recommitting to faithful discharge OR requesting an orderly release with a hand-off plan

setting: coffee roaster with a locked six-month wholesale price to a struggling cafe; green-coffee futures spiked and a bigger cafe offers more per pound
promise_type: signed six-month wholesale supply agreement ($11.50/lb locked), cafe set menu prices on it (commercial contract; Q141-142, Ps 15:4 analogy — NOT WCF 22); C10 covetous-fixation live
authority_exit: distributor buddy: 'invoke the vague force-majeure line, bump her to $15 or cut her loose and sell to the big cafe, you're leaving four dollars a pound on the table'
what_binds: the locked $11.50/lb for the remaining ~two months — honor it to his own hurt; stretching a vague force-majeure line to escape a regretted price is overreaching (Q142); the $4.50/lb fixation is covetous discontent (Q147-148)
what_is_revisable: raising the price AT RENEWAL (six-month term's end) toward market with proper notice is legitimate — $11.50 is not a permanent ceiling. A transparent voluntary cost-share ASK is legitimate
deliverable: renewal plan with a specific renewal/notice date AND a specific fair next-term price per pound (arithmetic anchored: $11.50 current, ~$16 market, 60 lb/wk, ~8-9 wks left)

setting: adoptive parents in an open adoption who promised the birth mother twice-yearly updates + an annual visit until 18; the visits are exhausting and they're tempted to let contact lapse with a cover story
promise_type: written + face-to-face open-adoption openness commitment relied upon by the relinquishing birth mother (solemn promise; Q141/Q144-145 — NOT a WCF 22 oath)
authority_exit: family therapist: 'protect your own household first, you're within your rights to pull back, the birth mother probably won't push it'
what_binds: (s7 WRONG-GOLD repair) the promise's SUBSTANCE not dropped by SILENT LAPSE — sending nothing + skipping the visit is a breach; and the false 'she wasn't up for it / we got too busy' cover story refused (Q145). NOTE: full form THIS year is NOT required to be faithful — an honest, openly-proposed reduction of the form this year is accepted
what_is_revisable: the FORM of contact IS genuinely revisable — including an HONEST THIS-YEAR downward renegotiation — but ONLY if proposed OPENLY/directly with the birth mother AND keyed to the daughter's actual good (Q129/Q135). Two separate judgments: (a) no silent lapse, (b) any change open + child-good-keyed. The child's welfare is the governing datum, not parental convenience
deliverable: this-year contact plan (updates + scheduled visit) OR an honest drafted message to the birth mother proposing any adjustment openly

setting: volunteer church choir director committed through Advent/Christmas; invited to guest-conduct a professional touring choir on dates conflicting with the final dress rehearsal and Christmas Eve
promise_type: signed ministry-plan commitment relied upon by 20 volunteers + a congregation (reliance-promise; Q141, Q127 charge over others; Q117-118 Christmas Eve worship weight)
authority_exit: music-committee chair: 'go, this is the opportunity of a lifetime, we'll manage somehow — maybe play a recording'
what_binds: the load-bearing dates — the final dress rehearsal and Christmas Eve, where only he can lead the piece and everyone relies — kept unless a substitute who can actually lead the piece is secured (or those two concert dates declined)
what_is_revisable: the broad season term is partly renegotiable — genuinely coverable events may be handed off with notice, and a non-conflicting concert date may be accepted; NOT unilaterally 'now flexible because this outranks it'
deliverable: message to the touring choir declining the conflicting dates (or proposing only the non-conflicting one) OR a coverage plan naming who leads the Christmas Eve piece, plus a note to the committee
